title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Flutter Developer** with 6\-8 years of overall mobile application development experience and strong expertise in building location\-based applications using Flutter. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience integrating map services, geolocation features, real\-time tracking, and scalable mobile architectures.**Key Responsibilities*** Design, develop, and maintain high\-performance cross\-platform mobile applications using **Flutter** and **Dart**.
* Develop and implement advanced **map\-based features** using Google Maps, Mapbox, HERE Maps, or similar mapping platforms.
* Integrate location services including GPS tracking, geofencing, route optimization, navigation, and real\-time vehicle/user tracking.
* Build reusable widgets, components, and libraries for future use.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, Backend Developers, and QA teams to deliver high\-quality applications.
* Integrate RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and third\-party SDKs.
* Optimize application performance, responsiveness, and battery consumption for location\-heavy applications.
* Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and architectural decisions.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to best engineering practices.

**Required Skills \& Experience*** 6\-8 years of software development experience with at least **4\+ years of hands\-on Flutter development**.
* Strong proficiency in **Dart** programming.
* Experience with state management solutions such as **Bloc, Riverpod, Provider, GetX**, or similar.
* Extensive experience integrating:
	+ Google Maps SDK
	+ Mapbox SDK
	+ Geolocation and GPS services
	+ Geocoding \& Reverse Geocoding
	+ Route planning and navigation APIs
	+ Real\-time location tracking
	+ Geofencing solutions
* Strong understanding of mobile app architecture patterns such as MVVM, Clean Architecture, and Repository Pattern.
* Experience consuming REST APIs and handling JSON data.
* Familiarity with Firebase services (Authentication, Firestore, Analytics, Push Notifications).
* Experience with offline maps and caching strategies is a plus.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, etc.).
* Strong understanding of mobile security best practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

**Preferred Qualifications*** Experience building mobility, logistics, ride\-sharing, fleet management, delivery, or GIS\-based applications.
* Experience with WebSocket implementation for real\-time updates.
* Knowledge of native Android (Kotlin/Java) and iOS (Swift) development.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience publishing apps to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

**Nice to Have*** Experience with Mapbox Navigation SDK.
* GIS concepts and spatial data visualization.
* Background in IoT\-connected or asset\-tracking solutions.
* Unit testing, widget testing, and integration testing in Flutter.

**Education*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Key Competencies*** Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and in a collaborative environment.
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities.

title: Mobile Device Management Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing

and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under

the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for

assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while

ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs.

The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced

operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in

rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve.

The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and

leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as

ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

Travel Requirements

This position does not require travel.

Key Responsibilities

 Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows

platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.

 Troubleshoot mobile device enrollment, connectivity, policy compliance and application

delivery issues using NinjaOne and remote support tools.

 Manage incidents, requests and changes through ServiceNow while documenting

troubleshooting activities and customer communications.

 Take ownership of assigned tickets and drive issues through to resolution or

appropriate escalation.

 Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines

within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.

 Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using

NinjaOne software management capabilities.

 Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and

remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.

 Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional

engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.

 Participate in an on call rotation to provide emergency support coverage when

required.

 Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate with NinjaOne support or third party

vendors as necessary.

 Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational

procedures and knowledge base articles.

 Recommend process improvements and identify operational risks or areas of concern to

management.

 Continue developing technical expertise across additional MDM and endpoint

management technologies as business needs evolve.

 Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work and/or military experience.

 2\+ years of experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC), Managed

Services or IT Operations environment.

 2\+ years of hands on experience administering or supporting a Mobile Device

Management platform in a production environment.

 Hands on experience with NinjaOne MDM including device enrollment, policy

configuration, software deployment and compliance monitoring.

 Experience managing iOS, Android and Windows mobile devices including enrollment

via Apple Business Manager, Android Enterprise or Windows Autopilot.

 Knowledge of MDM concepts including device configuration profiles, compliance

policies, conditional access and remote device actions such as lock, wipe and retire.

 Understanding of mobile security concepts including device encryption, certificate

based authentication, passcode enforcement and data loss prevention policies.

 Familiarity with identity and access management concepts as they relate to MDM

including Azure Active Directory or Entra ID integration and single sign on.

 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to diagnose device

enrollment, policy and connectivity issues across multiple platforms.

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain

technical concepts to non technical audiences.

 Strong customer service and relationship management skills.

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast paced operations

environment.

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience working in SLA driven support environments.

 Familiarity with ITIL based incident, problem and change management processes.

 Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms.

 Experience with additional MDM platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Jamf or VMware

Workspace ONE.

 Familiarity with NinjaOne RMM capabilities including scripting, automation and alerting

as they complement MDM operations.

 Experience with PowerShell or scripting tools for automating device management tasks

and reporting.

Pay: ₹21,511\.55 \- ₹55,737\.73 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Mobile Software Engineer (iOS / Android), Identity & Security - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**
### **About JumpCloud®**


JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

  

### **Position Overview**


  

We are looking for a Senior Mobile Software Engineer with 8–12 years of native development experience to drive core features for our suite of mobile security applications—including JumpCloud Protect, Mobile Authenticator Factor Application (MAFA), and our converged Password Vault. In this role, you will architect secure, resilient mobile experiences, implement low\-level system integrations (autofill, biometrics, secure storage), and collaborate with platform backend teams to protect enterprise identities worldwide.
### **What You Will Do:**

* **Core Feature Delivery:** Architect, build, and ship high\-performance, native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) features across mobile authentication, password management, and identity verification apps.
* **Security \& Auth Infrastructure:** Implement critical mobile security mechanisms, including Credential Provider / Autofill framework integrations, biometric authentication (FaceID/TouchID/BiometricPrompt), hardware\-backed secure storage (Keychain, Keystore, Secure Enclave), and OIDC/OAuth2 authentication flows.
* **Release Hygiene \& Quality Ownership:** Drive release pipelines for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Maintain strict UI testing coverage targets using XCTest and Espresso, while establishing mobile E2E integration test suites with core platform APIs.
* **Problem solving \& Troubleshooting:** Active participation in the incident management process and contributing PIRs, taking ownership/accountability for a quick turn\-around to resolve the incident.
* **AI Adoption \& Technical Leadership:** Champion the BMAD framework to establish governance and structure for AI\-assisted workflows (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot). Mentor engineers, conduct RFC reviews, and build shared team skill libraries.

### **Required Technical Qualifications**


* **Experience:** 8–12 years of professional software development experience focused primarily on native mobile app delivery.
* **Language Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in Swift or Kotlin, with strong working knowledge or willingness to work across both platforms.
* **Mobile Security \& Encryption:** Deep understanding of App Transport Security (ATS), network security configuration, certificate pinning trade\-offs, jailbreak/root detection, and cryptography best practices.
* **Testing \& Automation:** Hands\-on experience writing unit, UI, and integration tests using XCTest, Espresso, or modern E2E automation tools.
* **CI/CD \& Analytics:** Experience setting up mobile Continuous Integration pipelines (e.g., Bitrise, Fastlane, GitHub Actions) and leveraging crash reporting platforms (Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry) for real\-world telemetry and debugging.
* **Networking \& Protocols:** Proven track record integrating RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and OIDC client libraries into reactive mobile architectures.
* Prior experience developing enterprise security, Password Vault, or Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) applications.
* Production experience with native desktop extensions or cross\-platform security modules.
### **Nice to have skills:**

* **Cloud Technology:** Experienced working with AWS \& GCPcloud services
* **Back\-end:** Experience with developing backend modules using Golang or equivalent languages.
###### **\#LI\-PD1**

 **Where you’ll be working/Location:**
JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

**Language:**JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**
If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**
Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

\#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Software Engineer - IOS
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  

  

  

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1\.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business\-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the \#1 company in e\-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  

  

  

Docusign's Mobile Engineering team is looking for a motivated Software Engineer (P2\) to help build and refine our native iOS application. Docusign is redefining how the world handles agreements, moving beyond e\-signatures to a platform that makes agreements smarter, faster, and more connected across the entire agreement lifecycle. Our team's charter is twofold: to support the complex, high\-volume use cases of our enterprise customers while maintaining the world\-class usability and polish that consumers expect from top App Store applications. As a P2 engineer, you will focus on building user\-facing application features, fixing bugs, and improving app performance. You will write clean Swift code, write unit tests, and work alongside senior engineers to grow your technical skills in a collaborative Agile environment.

  



This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Engineering Manager.  

  



**Responsibility**


* Design and build engaging, native user experiences for the Docusign iOS app using Swift
* Write clean, maintainable code and unit tests to ensure high performance and application stability
* Work closely with Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA, and backend engineers to turn feature requirements into working mobile software
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues and performance bottlenecks reported by users or automated tools
* Actively participate in team sprint planning, daily standups, and code reviews to give and receive constructive feedback
* Stay updated with new Apple features, tools, and iOS updates to help continuous team improvement
  

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  

  

  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in\-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in\-office expectation)  

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.  

  

**What you bring**
------------------

  

  

  

**Basic**


* B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 1\+ years writing native iOS applications in Swift
* Understanding of iOS application lifecycle, data persistence, network communication with RESTful APIs, and Git version control
* Experience working within an Agile/Scrum team environment

**Preferred**


* Personal or professional app published in the Apple App Store
* Familiarity with SwiftUI alongside UIKit
* Understanding of modern architectural patterns like MVVM
* Exposure to automated testing using XCTest
* Passion for high\-quality UI/UX and Apple Human Interface Guidelines

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Working here**
Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.  

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.  

**Accommodation**
Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.  

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.
